# 🚀 Quick Start

**Build your first SUITE app in minutes**

---

## Prerequisites

- Node.js 18+ installed
- Discord account (for SUITE Hub)
- Basic understanding of JavaScript/React

---

## Step 1: Join SUITE Hub

Join the Discord server to get access to bot commands and community support.

[Join SUITE Hub →](https://discord.gg/suitehub)

---

## Step 2: Create Your App

Use the `/create-app` command in Discord:

```
/create-app name:MyFirstApp description:"A simple counter app"
```

The bot will scaffold a new Expo app for you.

---

## Step 3: Build with Cadence

Queue a prompt to build your app:

```
/addition prompt:"Add a button that increments a counter displayed on screen"
```

Cadence AI will generate the code and push it to your repo.

---

## Step 4: Test Locally

```bash
cd apps/MyFirstApp
npm install
npx expo start
```

Scan the QR code with Expo Go on your phone.

---

## Step 5: Publish

When ready, submit for review:

```
/publish app:MyFirstApp
```

After approval, your app will be live in the SUITE App Store!

---
